verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Connection Timeline showing sync history, logs, and errors (docs-10, docs-57), and a built-in notification system supporting email and webhook (docs-9, docs-26, docs-34); row-count/log detail is covered via timeline/log download. Slack is not explicitly named as a channel alongside email/webhook, and independent hands-on validation of alerting reliability is limited to general community praise/complaints unrelated to alerting specifically. Missing for 10: explicit mention of Slack as a notification channel, and independent verification of alert delivery in production.
